title: Regulation and Integration of Cell-Signaling Pathways
method: Retrieved root draft blob; counted Unicode lexical tokens only within explicit teaching-prose paragraphs, excluding markup, reference notes, headings, SVGs, tables and practice. Article count excludes SVG titles/descriptions and enlargement buttons but includes other student-facing article text.
comparator: Inspected published 3.C.14 reader at initial baseline and 4.A.07 at 8f7bcb45811d275bde044b710733ef0f0c187beb (14416 narrative words, 158 teaching paragraphs, 15 SVGs by same counting approach); similar narrative scale, reader reused; distinct regulatory focus.
scientific_checks: Official revised CSIR-NET and legacy syllabi and MP SET 2024 archived syllabus; roadmap coverage checked.

Checked GTP hydrolysis/RGS, GRK/arrestin and receptor trafficking, opposing phosphorylation and PTEN, PDE feedback, calcium recovery and buffers, scaffold specificity, cross-talk, temporal coding, adaptation and experimental inference.
Reviewed selected Alberts/NCBI teaching material and primary/review source records; added Benovic reconstitution, Traverse PC12 studies, and RGS9 knockout evidence with limitations.
Separate editorial pass revised 31 distractors, shuffled initial answer pattern, strengthened evidence, corrected diagram feedback/docking and marker handling; hypothetical datasets clearly marked.

arithmetic_checks.note: Recomputed G-protein active fractions and half-lives, messenger steady-state and decay, phosphorylation fractions, hypothetical data clearance rates, amplification and numerical practice; Q27 independently recalculated.

academic_self_review.method: Internal critical author review, not external peer review. Full roadmap scope; deductions for limited access to some full scientific papers, necessary reinforcement of concepts, abstract-level evidence for some experiments, a few straightforward distractors, and untested browser interactions.

limitations: Selected full text and bibliographic records only; not every cited source read in full.
State SET comparison used archived MP SET 2024 syllabus, not independently verified current MPPSC syllabus.
Static HTML/SVG/source validation; no interactive browser/mobile or formal accessibility audit.
New slug follows existing title-based convention. Deployment must be verified separately.
